Small Steps for Cambridge

Pick your year. Teach the steps in order, change the ones marked Adapt, skip the ones marked skip, and add the Cambridge objectives listed at the foot of each block.

How to read a block

Step 3Do: teach the WR step as normal.
Step 4Adapt: teach it with the change shown in orange beside it.
Step 5skip: not in Cambridge for your stage.
+ AddAdd: a Cambridge objective WR doesn't cover, with when to teach it. Hover to see the objective; click for how to teach it.

Step numbers follow the White Rose Maths small steps (2022 edition). Objective codes follow Cambridge Primary Mathematics (0096) and match the school's objective spreadsheets. Aut / Spr / Sum = Autumn, Spring, Summer; B = block; S = step.
